title: Jude the Obscure
author: Thomas Hardy
summary: Jude Fawley, a poor stonemason, dreams of studying at the university in Christminster. His hopes are thwarted by class barriers and by his tangled relationships with Arabella and his cousin Sue Bridehead.
readIf: you appreciate bleak Victorian tragedy that criticises class and marriage.
skipIf: you want a hopeful ending or are sensitive to the death of children.
